title: Infold
summary: INFOLD, verb intransitive [in and fold.] To involve; to wrap up or enwrap; to inclose. INFOLD his limbs in bands. 1. To clasp with the arms; to embrace. Noble Banco, let me infold thee, And hold thee

inlines.v: INFOLD, verb intransitive [in and fold.] To involve; to wrap up or enwrap; to inclose. INFOLD his limbs in bands. 1. To clasp with the arms; to embrace. Noble Banco, let me infold thee, And hold thee to my heart.
